Also known as: Gross Written Premium; GWP
Definition: The total premium on policies issued in the period, whether or not the cover period has yet elapsed.
The part of the premium that covers the portion of the policy period that has already passed.

Also known as: Claims Ratio
Definition: Claims costs as a share of premium: how much of each unit of premium is paid out in claims.
Operating expenses as a share of premium.
The loss ratio plus the expense ratio. Below 100% means the insurer earned an underwriting profit.

Also known as: Persistency Rate; Policy Persistency
Definition: The share of policies still in force after a given period.

Also known as: Policy Lapse Rate
Definition: The share of policies that ended because premiums stopped being paid.
The share of contracts, such as life or annuity policies, that customers cashed in early.

Also known as: In-Force Policies; PIF
Definition: The number of policies that are active at a given date.

Also known as: Annual Premium Equivalent; APE
Definition: A way to compare sales on one basis: premiums expressed as a yearly amount.
How often claims are made, usually per policy or per exposure period.

Also known as: Average Claim Cost
Definition: The average cost of a claim, found by dividing the total cost of claims by the number of claims. It shows how big claims are when they happen.
Sales of new policies or contracts in the period, as opposed to renewals of existing ones.

Also known as: NWP; Net Premium Written
Definition: The premium written after the part passed on to reinsurers has been taken off.

Also known as: NEP; Net Premium Earned
Definition: The part of net premium that relates to the period in which cover was provided, after reinsurance.

Also known as: Unearned Premium Reserve; UPR
Definition: The part of premium already received that relates to cover still to be given in the future.

Also known as: Premium Revenue; Total Premiums; Premiums Collected
Definition: The money received from policyholders for insurance cover in a period.

Also known as: Premium Growth Rate; GWP Growth
Definition: How much premium has grown or fallen compared with an earlier period, as a percentage.

Also known as: Average Premium per Policy; Premium per Policy
Definition: The average premium charged per policy. It is a basic gauge of the price level and mix of business.

Also known as: Rate Increase; Price Change; Average Rate Change
Definition: The average change in the price charged for the same cover compared with an earlier period.

Also known as: Renewal Premium Income; Renewals
Definition: The premium collected on policies that were renewed rather than newly written.

Also known as: New Business Premium Income; NBP; New Premium
Definition: The premium written on policies sold to new customers in a period.

Also known as: Policy Renewal Rate; Policy Retention; Customer Retention Insurance
Definition: The share of policies due for renewal that were actually renewed.

Also known as: Number of Policies; Policies Written; Total Policies
Definition: The number of policies the insurer holds or sold in a period.

Also known as: Cancelled Policies; Cancellation Ratio; Mid-Term Cancellation
Definition: The share of policies that were cancelled before the end of the cover period.

Also known as: Time to Issue Policy; Policy Turnaround Time; Quote to Bind Time
Definition: The time between a customer accepting a quote and the policy being issued.

Also known as: Quote Conversion; Hit Ratio; Quote to Policy
Definition: The share of quotes given that became policies.

Also known as: Incurred Claims; Total Claims Incurred; Incurred Losses
Definition: The claims paid in a period plus the change in the amount set aside for claims not yet paid.

Also known as: Paid Claims; Claims Payments; Paid Losses
Definition: The money paid out to settle claims in a period.

Also known as: Outstanding Claims Reserve; Case Reserves; Loss Reserves
Definition: The money set aside for claims that have been reported but not yet fully paid.

Also known as: IBNR; IBNR Reserve
Definition: An estimate of claims that have happened but have not yet been reported to the insurer.

Also known as: Number of Claims; Claims Reported; Claims Received
Definition: The number of claims reported in a period.

Also known as: Outstanding Claims; Claims Backlog; Unsettled Claims
Definition: The number of claims that have been reported and are not yet closed.

Also known as: Settled Claims; Closed Claims; Claims Settled
Definition: The number of claims finalised in a period.

Also known as: Large Loss; Major Claims; Large Loss Ratio
Definition: Claims above a set size, tracked separately because a few big claims can change the results.

Also known as: Burning Cost; Loss Cost
Definition: The part of the premium needed to pay expected claims, without any allowance for costs or profit.

Also known as: Claim Settlement Ratio; Settlement Rate
Definition: The share of claims received that were settled and paid.

Also known as: Claim Repudiation Ratio; Claims Declined; Rejected Claims
Definition: The share of claims that the insurer refused to pay.

Also known as: Claim Turnaround Time; Claims Cycle Time; Time to Settle
Definition: The average time taken to settle a claim from when it was reported.

Also known as: First Notice of Loss Response; FNOL Response Time; Claim Acknowledgement
Definition: The time taken to reply to a customer after a claim was first reported.

Also known as: Claims Overpayment; Leakage Rate; Overpaid Claims
Definition: Money paid out on claims that should not have been paid, or was paid at too high an amount, because of errors or weak controls.

Also known as: Reopened Claims; Claim Reopen Ratio
Definition: The share of closed claims that had to be opened again.

Also known as: Claims per Adjuster; Adjuster Caseload; Claims Handler Productivity
Definition: The number of claims handled by each claims adjuster in a period.

Also known as: Claims Expense; Claims Adjustment Expense; Loss Adjustment Expense
Definition: The cost of investigating, handling and settling claims, excluding the amounts paid to customers.

Also known as: LAE Ratio; ULAE Ratio
Definition: The cost of handling claims shown as a percentage of earned premium.

Also known as: Subrogation; Salvage and Subrogation
Definition: Money recovered by the insurer from another party who was responsible for the loss, after the insurer paid the customer.

Also known as: Fraud Rate; Fraudulent Claims; Suspected Fraud
Definition: The share of claims identified as fraudulent or suspicious, and the value saved by stopping them.

Also known as: Underwriting Result; Underwriting Income; Underwriting Gain
Definition: The profit or loss from writing insurance, found by taking claims and costs away from earned premium, before any investment income.

Also known as: Underwriting Profit Margin; Underwriting Result Margin
Definition: The underwriting profit shown as a percentage of earned premium.

Also known as: Acquisition Ratio; Commission Ratio; Acquisition Costs
Definition: The cost of winning new business, such as commission and marketing, shown as a percentage of premium.

Also known as: Broker Commission; Agent Commission
Definition: The money paid to agents and brokers for selling policies.

Also known as: Administrative Expense Ratio; Management Expense Ratio
Definition: The running costs of the insurer, other than claims and commission, shown as a percentage of premium.

Also known as: Net Combined; Combined Ratio Net of Reinsurance
Definition: The combined ratio worked out after reinsurance has been taken into account.

Also known as: Solvency Margin; Solvency Coverage Ratio
Definition: How far the insurer's capital exceeds what the regulator requires, showing whether it could meet its obligations in bad conditions.

Also known as: Ceded Premium; Reinsurance Premium; Premium Ceded
Definition: The premium passed to reinsurers in exchange for them taking on part of the risk.

Also known as: Reinsurance Recoverable; Reinsurance Recovered; Ceded Claims
Definition: The part of claims that the reinsurers pay back to the insurer.

Also known as: Net Retention; Retention Rate Premium; Premium Retention
Definition: The share of premium the insurer keeps for its own account after paying reinsurers.

Also known as: Investment Yield; Investment Return Insurance; Portfolio Yield
Definition: The income earned on the money the insurer holds in investments, such as from premiums not yet paid out.

Also known as: Insurance ROE; Operating ROE
Definition: The profit of the insurer shown as a percentage of shareholders' funds.

Also known as: EV; Value of In-Force; VIF
Definition: An estimate of the value of a life insurer's existing business, including future profits from policies already sold.

Also known as: VNB; New Business Value
Definition: The present value of the profits expected from policies sold in a period.

Also known as: VNB Margin; NBV Margin; New Business Profit Margin
Definition: The value of new business shown as a percentage of the annual premium on new sales.

Also known as: Sum Insured; Total Sum Insured; Insured Amount
Definition: The amount that will be paid if the insured event happens, such as a death or a loss of property.

Also known as: Total Insured Value; TIV; Risk Exposure
Definition: The total amount of risk the insurer has taken on, usually shown as the total of the amounts insured.

Also known as: Frequency of Losses; Incidence Rate
Definition: How often claims happen, usually shown per hundred or thousand policies or per year of cover.

Also known as: Death Rate; Mortality Experience; Actual to Expected Mortality
Definition: The rate at which insured people die, compared with the expected rate, used to price and check life insurance.

Also known as: Sickness Rate Insurance; Morbidity Experience; Incidence of Illness
Definition: The rate at which insured people fall ill or claim for sickness cover, compared with the expected rate.

Also known as: Sales per Agent; Policies per Agent; Advisor Productivity
Definition: The number of policies or amount of premium sold by each agent or advisor in a period.

Also known as: Advisor Persistency; Agent Retention; Active Agents
Definition: The share of an agent's policies that remain in force, or the share of agents who stay active.

Also known as: Bancassurance Premium; Bank Channel Share
Definition: The share of insurance sales made through bank branches, compared with other channels.

Also known as: Online Sales Share; Digital Premium Share; Direct Online Sales
Definition: The share of insurance sales made through websites and apps.

Also known as: Administration Cost per Policy; Servicing Cost per Policy; Policy Servicing Cost
Definition: The cost of running the business divided by the number of policies in force.

Also known as: Capital Requirement; SCR; Required Capital
Definition: The amount of capital the regulator requires the insurer to hold given the risks it has taken on.
